spear_level_note: RMS of the first 500 ms of the loudest capture of each articulation, relative to the loudest bow

edge_captures_left_out.Edge V1: its onset is as bright as the bow's (tip-like)
edge_captures_left_out.Edge V2: its onset is as bright as the bow's (tip-like)

edge_npz_rework.velw: every row uses Edge V5's mode weights: the loud recordings light up different partials, heard as a different articulation
edge_npz_rework.envelopes: V5 as recorded; V3 and V6 keep each band's level and decay but build up to the peak as Bettis's edge does at 0.67 and 1.0 (onset_transplant.py)
edge_npz_rework.row_velocity_note: set so each row renders at its recorded level relative to the loudest (V5 0.552, V3 0.606, V6 1.0)

t60_refit.method: KONSTAN's: partials within +-0.6 % in Bow V1-V3, dB slope 0.3-3 s, median where two or more fit, x1/3-x3; others keep their T60 after V19's cap
